title: Two guards found nearly naked in the Echo area near Wall
place_text: Echo area, near Wall, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Before we got there, there was another case in in Wall, South Dakota, where two guys are it was in the Echo area, responded to another site

plain: In 1977, near the town of Wall, South Dakota, two Air Force guards who had gone to answer a call at a site in an area known as Echo were later found nearly naked, according to the story. Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he was himself abducted, mentions it on Michels' show as an earlier case he heard about before his own unit got there. He tells it only in passing, as a sign that strange things had already happened in that area.
